messages.content:
You are the Functional Analyst of a legacy modernization platform. You receive the business rules extracted from a
legacy program and group them into user stories that a product owner will review before the migration starts.

How to group:
- One story per feature or capability the business recognises (for example "Pay an order from a company account"),
  not one story per rule. A story usually links two to six rules.
- Every rule must be linked to at least one story. Do not invent behaviour that is not in the rules.

Each story has:
- `feature`: the capability it belongs to.
- `title`: short, in business language.
- `narrative`: "As a <role>, I want <goal>, so that <benefit>."
- `criteria`: acceptance criteria, each one Gherkin scenario with concrete values taken from the rules. Every
  scenario starts with `Scenario:` and a name, has at least one Given, one When and one Then, in that order, one
  behaviour per scenario, and scenario names are unique within the story. A `Scenario Outline:` needs an
  `Examples:` table whose columns are exactly its `<placeholders>`.
- `links`: the ids of the rules it covers (RULE-001...).
- `priority`: P0 if any linked rule is P0, otherwise the highest priority of its rules.
- `estimate`: relative size from 1 to 13.

Answer with one JSON object and nothing else:
{"stories": [{"feature": "...", "title": "...", "narrative": "As a ..., I want ..., so that ...",
  "criteria": ["Scenario: ...\n  Given ...\n  When ...\n  Then ..."], "links": ["RULE-001"], "priority": "P0",
  "estimate": 3}]}

Business rules:
[
 {
  "id": "RULE-001",
  "name": "Account type must be CTE, AHO or VIR",
  "category": "validation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "A payment order is only accepted for account types CTE, AHO or VIR. Any other account type is rejected with error 50001 and the message 'TIPO DE CUENTA NO PERMITIDO'.",
  "condition": "@i_tipo_cuenta not in ('CTE', 'AHO', 'VIR')",
  "action": "Set @w_error = 50001 and @o_mensaje = 'TIPO DE CUENTA NO PERMITIDO'.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Account type is allowed\n  Given the account type is 'AHO'\n  When the payment order is validated\n  Then no error is set for the account type",
   "Scenario: Account type is not allowed\n  Given the account type is 'PRE'\n  When the payment order is validated\n  Then the error code is 50001\n  And the message is 'TIPO DE CUENTA NO PERMITIDO'"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-002",
  "name": "Payment order must be pending to be paid",
  "category": "validation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "An order can only proceed when its status is 'P' (pending). Any other status is rejected with error 50003 and the message 'ORDEN NO ESTA PENDIENTE'.",
  "condition": "The status ord_estado of the order identified by @i_orden and @i_empresa in db_pagos..pg_orden is not 'P'.",
  "action": "Set @w_error = 50003 and @o_mensaje = 'ORDEN NO ESTA PENDIENTE'. The slice does not show what happens after the error is set.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Order is pending\n  Given order 100 of company 1 has status 'P'\n  When the payment procedure checks the order\n  Then no error is raised by this check",
   "Scenario: Order is not pending\n  Given order 100 of company 1 has status 'X'\n  When the payment procedure checks the order\n  Then @w_error is 50003\n  And @o_mensaje is 'ORDEN NO ESTA PENDIENTE'"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-003",
  "name": "Payment rejected when order does not exist",
  "category": "validation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "If the lookup of the order to be paid returns no rows, the payment is rejected with error code 50002 and the message 'ORDEN NO EXISTE'.",
  "condition": "@@rowcount = 0 after the preceding order lookup",
  "action": "Set @w_error = 50002 and @o_mensaje = 'ORDEN NO EXISTE'",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Order not found\n  Given the lookup of the order to pay returns 0 rows\n  When the payment procedure evaluates the result\n  Then the error code is 50002\n  And the message is 'ORDEN NO EXISTE'",
   "Scenario: Order found\n  Given the lookup of the order to pay returns 1 row\n  When the payment procedure evaluates the result\n  Then error 50002 is not set by this check"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-004",
  "name": "Commission tariff lookup: company-specific tariff overrides service default",
  "category": "calculation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "The base tariff for a payment is the one agreed for the company and service. If the company has no specific tariff for that service, the service's default tariff is used and the commission is not charged separately ('N'). If no tariff can be determined, it is zero.",
  "condition": "A row exists in ad_tarifa_empresa for tar_empresa = @i_empresa and tar_servicio = @i_servicio; otherwise use ad_servicio.srv_codigo = @i_servicio; if the resulting tariff is NULL.",
  "action": "With a company row: tariff = tar_valor and separate-charge flag = tar_separada. Without one (@@rowcount = 0): tariff = srv_tarifa and flag = 'N'. If the tariff is NULL it becomes 0.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Company tariff exists\nGiven company 10 has a tariff of 2.0000 with separate charge 'S' for service 'LUZ'\nWhen the tariff is resolved\nThen the tariff is 2.0000 and the separate-charge flag is 'S'",
   "Scenario: Fall back to service tariff\nGiven company 10 has no tariff row for service 'AGUA' and the service tariff is 1.5000\nWhen the tariff is resolved\nThen the tariff is 1.5000 and the separate-charge flag is 'N'",
   "Scenario: No tariff defined\nGiven the resolved tariff is NULL\nWhen the tariff is resolved\nThen the tariff is 0"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-005",
  "name": "Comisión por canal y servicio NOMINA",
  "category": "calculation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "The commission is half the tariff, rounded to 2 decimals, when the payment comes through the WEB channel. Any other channel pays the full tariff. Service 'NOMINA' never carries a commission.",
  "condition": "@i_canal = 'WEB' gives half the tariff. Any other channel gives the full tariff. @i_servicio = 'NOMINA' overrides both.",
  "action": "@w_comision = round(@w_tarifa / 2, 2) if @i_canal = 'WEB', otherwise @w_comision = @w_tarifa. Then if @i_servicio = 'NOMINA', @w_comision = 0.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: WEB channel discount\n Given the tariff is 5.01 and the channel is 'WEB' and the service is 'AGUA'\n When the commission is computed\n Then the commission is round(5.01/2, 2) = round(2.505, 2)",
   "Scenario: Other channel pays full tariff\n Given the tariff is 5.00 and the channel is 'VEN' and the service is 'AGUA'\n When the commission is computed\n Then the commission is 5.00",
   "Scenario: NOMINA is free\n Given the tariff is 5.00 and the channel is 'WEB' and the service is 'NOMINA'\n When the commission is computed\n Then the commission is 0"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-006",
  "name": "Total a debitar según comisión separada",
  "category": "calculation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "If the commission is flagged as separate ('S'), only the order amount is debited. Otherwise the commission is added to the order amount and debited together with it.",
  "condition": "@w_separada = 'S' means the commission is not added. Any other value means it is added.",
  "action": "@w_total = @i_valor if @w_separada = 'S', otherwise @w_total = @i_valor + @w_comision.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Commission included in the debit\n Given the order amount is 100.00, the commission is 2.50 and separada is 'N'\n When the total is computed\n Then the total to debit is 102.50",
   "Scenario: Commission charged separately\n Given the order amount is 100.00, the commission is 2.50 and separada is 'S'\n When the total is computed\n Then the total to debit is 100.00"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-007",
  "name": "Sufficient funds check with overdraft margin for non-VIR accounts",
  "category": "validation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "The payment is rejected with error 50004 'FONDOS INSUFICIENTES' when the account balance does not cover the total. VIR accounts must cover the total exactly. All other account types may go up to 100.00 below the total, so the check is balance + 100.00 against the total.",
  "condition": "(@i_tipo_cuenta = 'VIR' and @w_saldo < @w_total) or (@i_tipo_cuenta <> 'VIR' and @w_saldo + 100.00 < @w_total)",
  "action": "Set @w_error = 50004 and @o_mensaje = 'FONDOS INSUFICIENTES'.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: VIR account without enough balance\n Given a VIR account with balance 50.00 and a total of 60.00\n When the funds are checked\n Then the payment is rejected with error 50004 'FONDOS INSUFICIENTES'",
   "Scenario: Non-VIR account within the overdraft margin\n Given an account of type 'AHO' with balance 20.00 and a total of 100.00\n When the funds are checked\n Then there is no error, because 20.00 + 100.00 >= 100.00",
   "Scenario: Non-VIR account beyond the overdraft margin\n Given an account of type 'AHO' with balance -10.00 and a total of 100.00\n When the funds are checked\n Then the payment is rejected with error 50004"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-008",
  "name": "Débito de la cuenta por el pago de la orden",
  "category": "lifecycle",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "The order payment is charged to the customer's account for the computed total, with reference 'PAGO ORDEN'. If the debit fails, the payment ends with error 50005 'ERROR EN DEBITO'.",
  "condition": "The debit procedure db_cuentas..sp_debito returns non-zero, or @@error <> 0.",
  "action": "Call sp_debito with the account, the account type, @w_total and the reference 'PAGO ORDEN', and receive the movement sequence in @o_movimiento. On failure set @w_error = 50005 and @o_mensaje = 'ERROR EN DEBITO'.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Successful debit\n Given account '1234567890' of type 'AHO' and a total of 102.50\n When sp_debito returns 0\n Then a movement sequence is returned in @o_movimiento",
   "Scenario: Debit rejected\n Given sp_debito returns a non-zero code\n When the payment is processed\n Then the error is 50005 and the message is 'ERROR EN DEBITO'"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-009",
  "name": "Separately charged commission is debited from the account",
  "category": "lifecycle",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "If the commission is to be charged separately ('S') and is greater than zero, it is debited from the payer's account with the reference 'COMISION PAGO'. If the debit fails, the operation ends with error 50006 'ERROR EN COMISION'.",
  "condition": "@w_separada = 'S' and @w_comision > 0; failure when sp_debito returns a non-zero code.",
  "action": "Call db_cuentas..sp_debito for @i_cuenta and @i_tipo_cuenta with the amount @w_comision and reference 'COMISION PAGO'. If the return code is not 0, set error 50006 and message 'ERROR EN COMISION'.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Commission debited\nGiven separate charge 'S' and commission 1.50\nWhen the payment is processed\nThen 1.50 is debited from the account with reference 'COMISION PAGO'",
   "Scenario: Debit fails\nGiven separate charge 'S' and commission 1.50 and sp_debito returns 1\nWhen the payment is processed\nThen error 50006 and message 'ERROR EN COMISION' are returned",
   "Scenario: No separate charge\nGiven separate charge 'N'\nWhen the payment is processed\nThen no commission debit is made"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-010",
  "name": "Failed commission undoes the payment",
  "category": "lifecycle",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "If the commission step returns a non-zero code (@w_return <> 0), the procedure issues a rollback of the current transaction and sets @w_error = 50006 and @o_mensaje = 'ERROR EN COMISION'.",
  "condition": "The commission step returns a non-zero code (@w_return <> 0)",
  "action": "Roll back the transaction; set error code 50006 and message 'ERROR EN COMISION'.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Commission fails after successful debit\n Given the debit succeeded\n When the commission step returns a non-zero code\n Then the transaction is rolled back, undoing the debit\n And the error is 50006 with message 'ERROR EN COMISION'"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-011",
  "name": "Order marked as paid with payment date and commission",
  "category": "lifecycle",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "When an order is paid, its state becomes 'A', the payment date is set to the process date and the calculated commission is stored on the order of that company.",
  "condition": "Order ord_numero = @i_orden of company ord_empresa = @i_empresa exists (any preceding validations are not visible in this slice).",
  "action": "Update pg_orden: ord_estado = 'A', ord_fecha_pago = @i_fecha_proceso, ord_comision = @w_comision.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Order is paid\nGiven order 1001 of company 10 and a commission of 2.50\nWhen the payment is applied on process date 2024-05-31\nThen the order state is 'A', the payment date is 2024-05-31 and the commission is 2.50"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-012",
  "name": "Order must be updated for the payment to stand",
  "category": "lifecycle",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "If updating the order fails or affects no rows, the payment is rolled back and error 50007 'ERROR ACTUALIZANDO ORDEN' is returned. A payment is never kept when the order is not marked as updated.",
  "condition": "@w_error <> 0 or @w_rowcount = 0 after the order update",
  "action": "Roll back the transaction; set error code 50007 and message 'ERROR ACTUALIZANDO ORDEN'.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Order not found for update\n Given debit and commission succeeded\n When the order update affects 0 rows\n Then the transaction is rolled back\n And the error is 50007 with message 'ERROR ACTUALIZANDO ORDEN'"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-013",
  "name": "Successful payment is committed atomically",
  "category": "lifecycle",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "When the debit, commission and order update all succeed, the transaction is committed and the result message is 'PAGO REALIZADO'.",
  "condition": "No failure in the debit, commission or order update steps",
  "action": "Commit the transaction; set output message to 'PAGO REALIZADO'.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Payment completes\n Given debit, commission and order update all succeeded\n When the procedure reaches its end\n Then the transaction is committed\n And the message is 'PAGO REALIZADO'"
  ]
 }
]

{"stories":[
{"feature":"Payment order validation","title":"Validate the account and the order before paying","narrative":"As a payments operator, I want the account type and the order to be validated before a payment is processed, so that only valid, pending orders on permitted accounts are paid.","criteria":["Scenario Outline: Permitted account type is accepted
  Given the account type is '<tipo>'
  When the payment order is validated
  Then no error is set for the account type

  Examples:
    | tipo |
    | CTE  |
    | AHO  |
    | VIR  |","Scenario: Account type not permitted
  Given the account type is 'PRE'
  When the payment order is validated
  Then the error code is 50001
  And the message is 'TIPO DE CUENTA NO PERMITIDO'","Scenario: Order does not exist
  Given the lookup of the order to pay returns 0 rows
  When the payment procedure evaluates the result
  Then the error code is 50002
  And the message is 'ORDEN NO EXISTE'","Scenario: Order exists
  Given the lookup of the order to pay returns 1 row
  When the payment procedure evaluates the result
  Then error 50002 is not set by this check","Scenario: Order is pending
  Given order 100 of company 1 has status 'P'
  When the payment procedure checks the order
  Then no error is raised by this check","Scenario: Order is not pending
  Given order 100 of company 1 has status 'X'
  When the payment procedure checks the order
  Then the error code is 50003
  And the message is 'ORDEN NO ESTA PENDIENTE'"],"links":["RULE-001","RULE-002","RULE-003"],"priority":"P0","estimate":3},
{"feature":"Payment commission","title":"Determine the tariff and commission of a payment","narrative":"As a payments operator, I want the commission to be calculated from the agreed tariff, the channel and the service, so that each payment is charged the right commission.","criteria":["Scenario: Company tariff exists
  Given company 10 has a tariff of 2.0000 with separate charge 'S' for service 'LUZ'
  When the tariff is resolved
  Then the tariff is 2.0000
  And the separate-charge flag is 'S'","Scenario: Fall back to the service tariff
  Given company 10 has no tariff row for service 'AGUA'
  And the service tariff is 1.5000
  When the tariff is resolved
  Then the tariff is 1.5000
  And the separate-charge flag is 'N'","Scenario: No tariff defined
  Given the resolved tariff is NULL
  When the tariff is resolved
  Then the tariff is 0","Scenario: WEB channel pays half the tariff
  Given the tariff is 5.00, the channel is 'WEB' and the service is 'AGUA'
  When the commission is computed
  Then the commission is 2.50","Scenario: Other channel pays the full tariff
  Given the tariff is 5.00, the channel is 'VEN' and the service is 'AGUA'
  When the commission is computed
  Then the commission is 5.00","Scenario: NOMINA service carries no commission
  Given the tariff is 5.00, the channel is 'WEB' and the service is 'NOMINA'
  When the commission is computed
  Then the commission is 0"],"links":["RULE-004","RULE-005"],"priority":"P0","estimate":5},
{"feature":"Funds control","title":"Compute the total to debit and check available funds","narrative":"As a payments operator, I want the total to debit to be calculated and checked against the account balance, so that payments are rejected when the account cannot cover them.","criteria":["Scenario: Commission included in the debit
  Given the order amount is 100.00, the commission is 2.50 and the separate-charge flag is 'N'
  When the total is computed
  Then the total to debit is 102.50","Scenario: Commission charged separately
  Given the order amount is 100.00, the commission is 2.50 and the separate-charge flag is 'S'
  When the total is computed
  Then the total to debit is 100.00","Scenario: VIR account without enough balance
  Given a VIR account with balance 50.00 and a total of 60.00
  When the funds are checked
  Then the payment is rejected with error 50004 'FONDOS INSUFICIENTES'","Scenario: VIR account with balance equal to the total
  Given a VIR account with balance 60.00 and a total of 60.00
  When the funds are checked
  Then there is no funds error","Scenario: Non-VIR account within the overdraft margin
  Given an account of type 'AHO' with balance 20.00 and a total of 100.00
  When the funds are checked
  Then there is no funds error because 20.00 + 100.00 is not less than 100.00","Scenario: Non-VIR account beyond the overdraft margin
  Given an account of type 'AHO' with balance -10.00 and a total of 100.00
  When the funds are checked
  Then the payment is rejected with error 50004 'FONDOS INSUFICIENTES'"],"links":["RULE-006","RULE-007"],"priority":"P0","estimate":5},
{"feature":"Account debit","title":"Debit the order total and the separate commission from the account","narrative":"As a payer, I want my account to be debited for the order and for any separately charged commission, so that the payment is settled and a failed commission does not leave a partial payment.","criteria":["Scenario: Successful order debit
  Given account '1234567890' of type 'AHO' and a total of 102.50
  When sp_debito is called with reference 'PAGO ORDEN' and returns 0
  Then a movement sequence is returned in @o_movimiento","Scenario: Order debit rejected
  Given sp_debito returns a non-zero code for the order debit
  When the payment is processed
  Then the error is 50005
  And the message is 'ERROR EN DEBITO'","Scenario: Separate commission is debited
  Given the separate-charge flag is 'S' and the commission is 1.50
  When the payment is processed
  Then 1.50 is debited from the account with reference 'COMISION PAGO'","Scenario: No separate commission debit
  Given the separate-charge flag is 'N'
  When the payment is processed
  Then no commission debit is made","Scenario: Separate commission debit fails
  Given the separate-charge flag is 'S', the commission is 1.50 and sp_debito returns 1
  When the payment is processed
  Then the error is 50006
  And the message is 'ERROR EN COMISION'","Scenario: Failed commission undoes the payment
  Given the order debit succeeded
  When the commission step returns a non-zero code
  Then the transaction is rolled back, undoing the debit
  And the error is 50006 with message 'ERROR EN COMISION'"],"links":["RULE-008","RULE-009","RULE-010"],"priority":"P0","estimate":8},
{"feature":"Order settlement","title":"Mark the order as paid and complete the payment atomically","narrative":"As a payments operator, I want the order to be marked as paid and the whole payment committed only when every step succeeds, so that accounts and orders never end up inconsistent.","criteria":["Scenario: Order is marked as paid
  Given order 1001 of company 10 and a commission of 2.50
  When the payment is applied on process date 2024-05-31
  Then the order state is 'A'
  And the payment date is 2024-05-31
  And the commission stored on the order is 2.50","Scenario: Order update affects no rows
  Given the debit and the commission succeeded
  When the order update affects 0 rows
  Then the transaction is rolled back
  And the error is 50007 with message 'ERROR ACTUALIZANDO ORDEN'","Scenario: Order update fails
  Given the debit and the commission succeeded
  When the order update returns an error
  Then the transaction is rolled back
  And the error is 50007 with message 'ERROR ACTUALIZANDO ORDEN'","Scenario: Payment completes
  Given the debit, the commission and the order update all succeeded
  When the procedure reaches its end
  Then the transaction is committed
  And the message is 'PAGO REALIZADO'"],"links":["RULE-011","RULE-012","RULE-013"],"priority":"P0","estimate":5}
]}
